Surrounding Braixen (Japanese: テールナー、囲う , Surround) is the 576th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 28th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Korrina begins attacking Celosia.
Essentia attempts to fool 's group with her suit's camouflage abilities, but the wild stops her.
Xerosic has Essentia retreat.
Diantha and Malva continue their battle.
The sinks into the ground, despite and 's efforts to stop it.
Korrina defeats Celosia, but her is knocked out as well.
As she celebrates her victory, Celosia's sneaks behind Korrina and attacks.
finds Korrina on the ground, unconscious and her Key Stone removed from her Mega Glove.
